description: AddTempoEmailTemplateEditor — UI plus the model side, and NOT the local render engine. The host supplies IEmailPreviewRenderer (typically a server endpoint) and optionally ITemplateValidator; for a local render add the Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates.Engine package and call AddTempoEmailTemplateEngine. AddTempoEmailTemplates is the [Obsolete] pre-2.10 shortcut and delegates here without registering an engine.
